'''Defel-nator Old School Overkill (MISC)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Defel-nator]]
* '''Published:''' 4 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut|Premiere-L-tatooineobiwanshut.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 OWHut Defel-nator LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Well I was lucky to have just one Obi Wan in 1995, but with the old school prize support and Reflections and sealed decks you just accumulate cards over time.  I never would have dreamed of a deck like this, but now it is so powerful.  Interesting how 7 years of the game will make you look at the first set differently.  First off, with 5 x Revo you may get the chance to use this first turn... if not look for Obi and Luke and hold a destiny adder - stock your sense/alter and be ware of The Circle is Now Complete.  You should be able to get out on the ground with the Revo's working you can out generate your opponent and that should help you with the sense/alter wars THAT WILL TAKE PLACE!!!  By the time you get that won, you should have a OMDH set up and this is so broken that it never should have been invented.  There is no match for Han in the Falcon ALL ALONE!!! (Except for a Lateral Damage and DS-61-2 in Black 2 and a Tallon Roll. (See about the sense alter))  If you can protect the Savrip that is game - the light side is way BROKEN with uncontrolled reterval and the savrip - forget about the Bacta Tank Savrip owns - if you keep on the right side of the Sense Alter you win easy.
